gloss: above all; most importantly; without a doubt

definitions.gloss: above all; most importantly; without a doubt
definitions.explanation: Used to single out the most outstanding or decisive point in an argument or description. Literally "no matter what one says," it dismisses other considerations and asserts the main point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何|なん}といっても⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧だ。
examples.english: When it comes to summer, nothing beats beer.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売|う}り→売り：12159_uri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{何|なん}といっても⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{安|やす}さだ。
examples.english: This shop's selling point is, above all, its low prices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何|なん}といっても⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{優|やさ}しい⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧だ。
examples.english: Her greatest charm is, without a doubt, that she's kind to everyone.

notes:
Used to emphasize the single most important or compelling factor. Often appears at the start of a clause or right before the highlighted noun phrase, frequently in the pattern A⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧なんといってもB ("as for A, above all it's B").

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何|なん}といっても～: as for ~, above all it's ~
- {何|なん}といっても～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧: above all, ~ is the best
- {何|なん}といっても～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良|よ}さ→良さ：27828_yosa⟧: the great thing about ~ above all

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦やはり→やはり：01991_yahari⟧ / ⟦やっぱり→やっぱり：03005_yappari⟧: as expected; still — confirms expectation rather than ranking importance
- ⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧: especially — flags one item among several, weaker emphasis
- なに⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧: more than anything — close in meaning; slightly more emotional
